text_block_list.text: One day, a fan letter arrived for Marvelous Sunday.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Marvelouuus☆★☆
What kind of letter is it! Let's open it up★
However, what came out of the envelope wasn't a document, but a crayon drawing that looked like avant-garde art.

It was completely filled with pink, red, and green,
leaving virtually no white space remaining.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: This is... This is truly marvelous☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
It looks just like how I look
when I'm running☆

Looking at the back of the drawing paper, a note read,
"This is a drawing of Marvelous Sunday-san by my 3-year-old daughter.
We are cheering for you together."

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Yay~☆ Having such a marvelous
picture drawn for me★
Racing really is the absolute most marvelous☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: "Hey Trainer, do I really look this marvelous when I run?"

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
The marvelous really is getting through☆
Next time, I'll convey my feelings
even moooore marvelously!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
If we do that, this child
will paint an even more marvelous picture!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: "And that's why I'm gonna work hard to run even more, MORE Marvelous!"

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
My running is getting more and more marvelous!
And my art is getting more and more marvelous too!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Their Marvelous continued to expand, eventually culminating into one giant Marvelous! ☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: A marvelous perpetual motion machine is complete☆
choice_data_list: This turned into quite an epic tale.
This turned into quite an epic story, huh?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Yes! It has to be grand!
Because we're about to cause a Marvelous Big Bang☆
"Feeling the tangible sensation of ‘Marvelous’ steadily spreading across the world, Marvelous Sunday overflowed with motivation."
